n: DSS Professional V8 Redundancy Backup License
d: The Dahua DSS8PRRB is a Redundancy Backup license for DSS Professional V8. It enables high-availability deployment by providing server redundancy and automatic failover, helping ensure continuous operation of enterprise video management and security systems with minimal service interruption.

specs.label: Base license
